title: PRospective Integrative Oncology Registry
summary:
The prospective register Integrative Oncology (PRIO) collects data from cancer patients at the CCCU to determine which cancer patients use which additional therapies or measures of integrative oncology. The aim is also to determine whether there are any special features regarding quality of life and treatment satisfaction in these patients.
Integrative oncology measures include lifestyle changes, such as changes in diet, exercise and physical activity, sleep and stress management, mind-body interventions and body therapies such as acupuncture, massage, meditation, MBSR, yoga, tai chi, as well as complementary medicines and dietary supplements.
The study will be kept as a register and will also serve as a basis for future studies in the field of integrative oncology.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients diagnosed with cancer treated at the CCCU
Written informed consent
Ability to understand character and individual consequences of the clinical trial
Exclusion criteria:
Clinically significant concomitant disease critically influencing the ability of the patient to protocol adequate behavior
Any finding that, in the judgment of the study investigator, renders the participant unsuitable for the study protocol
